core_obligations: Construct the map (proof lines 11523-11549): the author defines a canonical map from the colimit description of j_!F to the sections of j_*F, using that a section supported in the image of an etale map over X can be viewed as a section of the direct image.

Show injectivity (proof lines 11552-11568): for an element written as a finite sum of sections with supports in the images of etale maps, the author shows that vanishing in j_*F forces each summand to vanish, using separatedness of j to separate the supports.
The case of sheaves of Lambda-modules is treated by the same construction, since all the functors involved are defined on modules as well.
proof_roadmap: Define the canonical map from the colimit definition of extension by zero into the direct image.
Write an element as a finite sum with disjoint supports and use separatedness to separate them.
Conclude injectivity, and note the module case.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a functorial injective map j_!F -> j_*F for a separated etale morphism j : U -> X, on abelian sheaves and on sheaves of modules (statement lines 11516-11521). The proof constructs the map from the colimit description of extension by zero (proof lines 11523-11549) and then proves injectivity by writing an element as a finite sum of sections with supports in the images of etale maps and separating those supports using separatedness of j (proof lines 11552-11568). The non-formal content is exactly the separation argument. The claim is H2: one construction plus one injectivity argument, both written out.
